items.claim: Collapsed nested timeline's bar drawn at the parent's start, not the track's `at`
Read-only graph lane's arrow key moving the selection and focus to another key
Rows four or more deep losing their label indent
Canceled dope-sheet drag reordering keys that share a time
Key drag placing the key through the press-time window
Ruler scrub seeking through the press-time window
Uncontrolled zoomed window not re-clamped when `duration` shrinks
Segment selection surviving a key selected through a controlled `selection`, and surviving edits that renumber its track's keys (A, plus B's graph-mode and external-edit case)
Nested timeline with no `duration` drawing a zero-width bar, and a negative one a negative width
items.note: A nested timeline with an infinite `duration` now runs its bar to the window's end.

items.claim: Releasing a key drag commits against the press-time tracks, undoing an edit made mid-drag
items.note: This was a behavior call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: while a press on the lanes is held, Delete, Backspace and arrow-key edits on a key or the root are refused, and Escape still cancels. Edits that come from the inspector or the consumer during a drag are still not guarded.
